title: Galaxy code card
description: A near-black panel with 14px corners and a faint border holding a few lines of monospace code: a grey file label over a hairline, then syntax-coloured lines (grey comments, blue keys, green strings) ending in a green block cursor that blinks.
notes: CSS-only blink; the cursor stays solid with reduced motion
key and string colours are --chart-2 and --highlight
name: galaxy-code-card

props.name: label
props.description: the grey label over the rule, e.g. "// ledger.settle"

props.name: lines
props.description: the code, one array of tokens per line

props.name: indented
props.description: indent these line numbers (0-based) by two characters

props.name: cursor
props.description: end the last line with a blinking block cursor
